(()=>{window.demoRead=()=>{const el=document.querySelector('.architect-workspace');return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('xray:architect:v1:'+encodeURIComponent(el.dataset.designId)))};window.demoLevel=document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Design level"]').value;window.demoPause=ms=>new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,ms));window.demoPoint=async(x,y)=>{const svg=document.querySelector('svg[aria-label="Editable architectural plan"]');const pt=new DOMPoint(x,y).matrixTransform(svg.getScreenCTM());svg.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{bubbles:true,clientX:pt.x,clientY:pt.y,pointerId:1}));await demoPause(600);svg.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true,button:0,buttons:1,clientX:pt.x,clientY:pt.y,pointerId:1}));svg.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{bubbles:true,button:0,clientX:pt.x,clientY:pt.y,pointerId:1}));await demoPause(900);};if(demoRead().walls.some(w=>w.levelId===demoLevel))throw Error('Expected the new empty demonstration level');return {level:demoLevel,viewBox:document.querySelector('svg[aria-label="Editable architectural plan"]').getAttribute('viewBox')};})()
(async()=>{await demoPoint(1000,6000);await demoPoint(4500,6000);if(!demoRead().lines.some(l=>l.levelId===demoLevel))throw Error("Line not saved");return "Line drawn and saved"})()
(async()=>{await demoPoint(6500,6000);await demoPoint(7100,6000);if(!demoRead().circles.some(c=>c.levelId===demoLevel))throw Error("Circle not saved");return "Circle drawn and saved"})()
